summary: ADR-0094 hybrid REAL-TIME replication, repository-only / DARK. The ADR-0074 signed ingestion endpoint accepted a master event and triggered nothing, so copy only happened on the ~2-min observer (the 2026-11-12 demo detected the master OPEN ~84s late; no follower order placed). New DARK flag COPIER_IMMEDIATE_DISPATCH_ENABLED makes ingestion the PRIMARY trigger: trade_copier/immediate_dispatch.py synchronously runs the existing governed producers in-line for that master (project->replicate->execute->lifecycle->mutation-dispatch), so the follower order is SUBMITTED immediately (target <=1s, ceiling <=2s source->submission; broker fill measured separately), reusing every gate + per-pair admission unchanged. Push/poll dedup through the one shared MasterEvent ledger + baseline; the slow observer is reconciliation-only. New CopierRealtimeDispatch latency-evidence model (+ migration 0013). Governed-close prerequisite solved route-scoped (never global). DARK/default-OFF; no deploy, no flag enablement, no authorization, no host contact, no broker order.
root_cause: ADR-0074 built the fast path (emitter, signed ingestion endpoint, CopierIngestedRevision, event projection) as isolated DARK pieces and left the ingestion->projection->replication->execute chain UNWIRED: SignedEventIngestView.post persisted a CopierIngestedRevision and returned 200 with no downstream trigger; projection/replication/execute/dispatch were separate on-demand/scheduled commands running on the ~2-min observer cadence.
change: 1) New flag copier_immediate_dispatch_enabled (flags.py). 2) trade_copier/immediate_dispatch.py: dispatch_master_realtime orchestrator (gated, fail-safe, latency-instrumented) runs the existing governed producer passes in-line for one master; it changes only WHEN they run, never WHAT they may do (every sub-gate + admission re-read under existing locks). 3) event_ingestion_api.py: gated, fail-safe trigger after ingest_revisions (byte-identical when OFF). 4) CopierRealtimeDispatch latency model (+ migration 0013). 5) execution/bridge_config.py: route-scoped MT5_LIVE_READONLY_POSITIONS_ENABLED (LIVE account + default-OFF COPIER_FOLLOWER_READONLY_POSITIONS_ENABLED + the account being the follower of a live, non-revoked, unexpired authorization) + follower_positions_read_readiness. 6) copier_live_demo_preflight.py: FOLLOWER_POSITIONS_READ_* readiness (non-blocking). Docs: ADR-0094, COPIER_LIVE_WORKER_SEQUENCE.md, COPIER_46_48_DEMO_RUNBOOK.md, STATUS.md, KNOWN_ISSUES.md.

status_detail: PASS (repository-only / DARK). Immediate OPEN/MODIFY/CLOSE replicate synchronously with honest source->submission <=2s in deterministic tests; push/poll dedup and fail-closed gates proven; route-scoped read permission is default-OFF and never global. With COPIER_IMMEDIATE_DISPATCH_ENABLED OFF (the default) ingestion is byte-identical to ADR-0074. No production mutation.

adversarial_review.reviewer: independent agent (fresh context), 15 attack vectors, read immediate_dispatch/event_ingestion_api/flags/models/bridge_config/preflight + the inherited producers/admissions
adversarial_review.money_path: SAFE (inherited): duplicate order, push/poll race, replay-after-restart, wrong tenant, wrong symbol/case, stale/expired/consumed authorization, admission expiry mid-flight, ticket misbinding, MODIFY-before-OPEN, CLOSE-after-UNKNOWN, global live relaxation, return-to-OFF -- all covered by the UNCHANGED governed producers/admissions which re-check every gate under their own locks; the orchestrator only changes WHEN they run.
adversarial_review.HIGH_A_sync_bridge_io_in_handler: FIXED -- removed the synchronous bounded reconcile (bridge reads + time.sleep) from the ingestion request path entirely; it was also premature (a just-minted PLACE_ORDER is PENDING, so it could not link). Follower-ticket linkage now happens via reconcile AFTER the bridge fill; OPEN submission latency (<=2s) is unaffected. Documented in ADR-0094 Known limitations.
adversarial_review.MEDIUM_B_dishonest_latency: FIXED -- recompute_latencies now measures source->submission from the TRUE broker detection time (event_detected_at), not the emitter self-report, and flags physically-impossible NEGATIVE (forward clock skew) and None as is_late (never a flattering sub-2s). New regression tests test_measured_from_detection_not_emitter + test_negative_skew_is_late_not_on_time.
adversarial_review.MEDIUM_C_asymmetric_modify_close_gating: FIXED -- MODIFY/CLOSE producers now gated on the same master execute gate as OPEN (each producer re-reads its own per-op LIVE arm/authority or the DEMO arm and fails closed), so the fast path is symmetric across OPEN/MODIFY/CLOSE on both DEMO and LIVE.
adversarial_review.MEDIUM_D_missing_evidence_on_fault: FIXED -- latency rows are now written in a contained path that runs even when a producer raises, so a produced order can never lack a CopierRealtimeDispatch row; a fault yields a CONTAINED outcome row. Regression: test_internal_fault_is_contained_not_raised.
adversarial_review.MEDIUM_A_global_sweep_scoping: DOCUMENTED -- the producer passes are the existing governed, idempotent, single-flight GLOBAL sweeps (limit=50); strict per-master isolation under multi-master backlog is a scoping limitation (never a wrong/duplicate order). Docstrings + ADR-0094 Known limitations corrected to state this accurately; per-master-scoped producers are a follow-up.
adversarial_review.LOW_E_submitted_counts_shadow: FIXED -- submitted now counts only real submissions (outcome != NO_ACTION).
adversarial_review.LOW_F_multi_follower_latency: FIXED -- one latency row per (event, follower) replication, not one arbitrary follower.
adversarial_review.LOW_credential_masked_ticket_docstring: FIXED -- model docstring corrected (the stored master ticket is an audit identifier, not a credential; not masked).
adversarial_review.LOW_G_partial_close_not_fast_pathed: DOCUMENTED -- PARTIAL_CLOSE keeps its dedicated worker path (exposure-reducing); a latency gap, not a safety gap; noted in ADR-0094.

migration_status: One new migration trade_copier/0013_copier_realtime_dispatch.py (Create model CopierRealtimeDispatch). makemigrations --check introduces no further trade_copier/execution drift. Unrelated pre-existing index-rename drift in signal_intake/strategies exists on main and is NOT touched by this PR.
limitations: Repository-only / DARK: not merged, not deployed; production unchanged; all copier/execution controls OFF; COPIER_IMMEDIATE_DISPATCH_ENABLED and COPIER_FOLLOWER_READONLY_POSITIONS_ENABLED default-OFF.

The producer passes are the existing global, idempotent, single-flight sweeps (limit=50); strict per-master isolation under multi-master backlog is a documented scoping limitation (never a wrong/duplicate order).

Follower-ticket linkage is NOT on the synchronous request path (a PENDING order cannot be linked, and blocking broker I/O in the ingestion handler is avoided); it happens via reconcile after the bridge fill. A fast, post-fill, event-driven reconcile is a follow-up; the OPEN submission latency (<=2s) is unaffected.

Latency acceptance was proven on deterministic synthetic/in-DB fixtures (no real bridge/broker); the live source->submission measurement path is exercised only when the feature is enabled + a host emitter is present (separate gated step).
Backend tests were run with Python 3.11 against a local PostgreSQL; CI runs the authoritative suite.
Not run here: full execution suite (only the bridge/readonly-relevant modules), frontend (untouched by this PR).
reviewer: Independent adversarial agent (15 attack vectors) + the author's deterministic mutation-killing suite. No CRITICAL; money path inherited-safe; all HIGH/MEDIUM findings fixed with regression tests or documented as reviewed non-safety limitations. See adversarial_review.
